payload.title: Capture video thumbnails when the CLI adds a Reference, and show which videos have none
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-11-05: thumbnail capture must run locally because YouTube refuses cloud addresses, so the CLI should capture a video's thumbnail at once when it adds a Reference (create-from-catalog and every add path). References added through the cloud MCP server or the Newsroom Add dialog still need a local capture-thumbnails run. Make that visible: the CLI reports N videos waiting for a thumbnail, and/or the Newsroom shows which videos have no picture. Scope to settle with Ryan. Gherkin.
